title: Okon's Inaction Figure, Part 3
description: Okon's Inaction Figure, Part 3 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Okon

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Return to UndercoverPancakes975 in Level 2 of MutantMania. Teach him a lethon--I mean lesson--and get back Okon's check. Return the check to Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Okon

Repeatable: No

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Return to UndercoverPancakes975 in Level 2 of MutantMania. Teach him a lethon--I mean lesson--and get back Okon's check. Return the check to Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Wah! *Sniffle* UndercoverPancaketh975 thold me an action figure with a buthted leg! He cheated me!

What time ith it? UndercoverPancaketh975 told me he liketh to hang out in MutantMania'th Level 2 around thith time.

Would you help me again and get my check back from him? Also, he'th a bad man and you should teach him a lethon about honethty!

Turn-in:

You got my check back for me? Wowie! I thought I would never get it back! You mutht be a great fighter...almost as good ath Menathing Manglefeet the Murderouth, I bet!

Objectives:

  • Teach UndercoverPancakes975 a Lesson
  • Okon's check ×1

Client level range: 81–100
